original.statement: cert-manager 1.18.0 promotes the `AdditionalCertificateOutputFormats` feature to GA, making additional certificate output formats always enabled regardless of the previous feature gate setting.

decision.reason: [ev-bc29bf53aa1b] names the `AdditionalCertificateOutputFormats` feature and says it is promoted to GA, so the additional formats are always enabled. That makes the feature-gate subject correct as spelled, with no component, since the text names none. The evidence does not give before/after default values or say the gate was removed, so default-changed and removed are not supported. That leaves behavior-changed with no literal values.
